id.description: ID of a person, workspace or virtual line.

firstName.description: First name of a person, workspace or virtual line.

lastName.description: Last name of a person, workspace or virtual line.

displayName.description: Display name of a person, workspace or virtual line.

type.description:
Type of the person, workspace or virtual line.
 * `PEOPLE` - Indicates that this object is a user.
 * `PLACE` - Indicates that this object is a place.
 * `VIRTUAL_LINE` - Indicates that this object is a virtual line.

email.description: Email of a person or workspace.

numbers.description: List of phone numbers of a person, workspace or virtual line.
